## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Checklist
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] New detections emit the finding schema (evidence, confidence) and have a knowledge-base entry
- [ ] Docs updated (README / CHANGELOG) if user-facing
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or justified)

## Notes
Anything reviewers should know (backward-compat, security impact).
